reference: GNU coreutils 9.7 tac, invoked by system Bash on the reference side; stderr is compared byte for byte after the shell's script-line prefix is removed.
coverage: Guest compatibility pass 6 (G90): GNU diagnostic wording for operand and usage errors.
exclusions: Only diagnostics are covered here; the reviewed suite in suites/ covers ordinary operation.

cases.purpose: G90: GNU tac's 'failed to open ... for reading' with the operand quoted, later operands still printed, and the coreutils Try line after an option error.
cases.script:
printf 'a\nb\n' > f
{ tac nosuch f || echo rc=$?; } 2>err
{ tac 'a b' || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ tac --bogus || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ tac -s || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
sed 's/^fixture: line [0-9]*: //' err >&2
rm err
